articles.summary: Tigo Energy’s Chief Growth & Revenue Officer Jing Tian recently joined Benoy Thanjan on the Solar Maverick Podcast to discuss how the solar industry is evolving into a future defined by smarter electronics, software-driven performance insights, and Energy Intelligence.
articles.title: Solar Maverick Podcast: Jing Tian on Smarter Solar, MLPE, AI, and Energy Intelligence

articles.summary: In pv magazine USA's recent article titled "2026 is set to be a year of reset, repowering, and resilient growth", JD Dillon, Tigo Energy’s Chief Marketing and Customer Experience Officer, highlights three key trends that will shape where the solar industry heads next: a breakout year for repowering, the rise of the U.S. solar “middle market”, and the expanding influence of global safety requirements.
articles.title: 2026: A Year of Reset, Repowering, and Global Safety Alignment
